Preserve its orange top binding band, blue triangular right support and blue bottom base, cream page stack visible on right edge, slight three-quarter perspective, variable white scissor-cut paper border, lifted lower-right cream page corner and subtle paper crease. Remove ALL existing wording and numerals: no KASIM and no 12. On the cream front page hand-letter ONLY the exact Turkish weekday CUMA in LARGE dark navy uppercase, one readable word on ONE SINGLE centered horizontal line. Correct spelling CUMA. Fit the entire word comfortably WITHIN the cream page; slightly smaller letters if needed, do not split the word across lines. No date, month, year, other words, numbers or grid. Leave surrounding cream page area blank to make the one weekday clear. All letters are ink on the same calendar page, not separate letter cutouts. Strong directional orange and blue felt-tip marker strokes, irregular child navy outline, opaque paper drawing. One calendar alone, no desk, person, backdrop or shadow.  Roots & Talks child's dense felt-tip-marker drawing on ONE connected white scissor-cut PAPER silhouette. Strongly visible broad directional ink strokes, dark overlaps and a few tiny white missed slivers. Wobbly thick navy outlines, naïve irregular hand drawing, uneven variable-width white scissor margin. A small visibly curled paper corner and subtle crease. Requested 3840x2160 landscape true RGBA with fully transparent exterior; no backdrop, cast shadow, pencil, crayon, pastel, textile, vector, grid, collage, unrequested text or logo. Keep the whole silhouette inside central 75 percent width and height with ample transparent margins; no cropping. One object alone.
